name: eased
description: Eased is a library of motion-first React components for shadcn, installed with the shadcn CLI. Built on React 19, Tailwind CSS v4 and Motion, with free components under the MIT licence; the source lands in your project.

items.name: eased-tokens
items.title: Eased stylesheet
items.description: The colours, shadows, radius roles, UI type sizes, springs, utilities (radius-nested, hit-area, focus-ring …) and variants (hover-fine, reduced) every Eased component reads. Installs into your global CSS without touching shadcn/ui's theme or Tailwind's defaults: every raw variable is prefixed --eased-, light follows :root, dark follows .dark.
items.docs: Merged into your global CSS: there is no eased.css to import. Light follows :root and dark follows a .dark class or data-theme="dark" on an ancestor.

@utility fade-x.mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, #000 var(--fade-start, 0px), #000 calc(100% - var(--fade-end, 0px)), transparent)

items.name: eased-motion
items.title: Eased motion
items.description: The named springs (snappy, smooth, bouncy), tweens, a hydration-safe useSafeReducedMotion and press classes every Eased component shares, matching the springs in the Eased stylesheet, plus small DOM and platform helpers (isEditable, useScrollFades, useIsMac) and a true-minus number formatter.

items.name: eased-demo-frame
items.title: Demo frame
items.description: The shell every Eased demo renders in: 420px tall, shrinks to its container, one 48px header style.

items.name: undo-pill
items.title: Undo Pill
items.description: Undo toast for React and shadcn: a pill with a draining countdown ring that commits the destructive action only when it runs out.
items.docs: Import UndoPill from components/eased/undo-pill/undo-pill. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. useUndoQueue() handles batching, undo and commit. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: A pill that rises after a destructive action with a draining countdown ring. Undo (or ⌘Z / Ctrl+Z) reverts it; only expiry commits it. Hover or focus pauses the countdown.

items.name: undo-pill-demo
items.title: Undo Pill demo
items.description: A file list where deleting a row shows the Undo Pill.

items.name: concentric-frame
items.title: Concentric Frame
items.description: Concentric border radius frame for React and shadcn: nested corners take the outer radius minus padding and border, through CSS variables.
items.docs: Import Frame, FrameInner and useFrame from components/eased/concentric-frame/concentric-frame. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: A layout primitive that keeps nested corners parallel: the inner radius is the outer radius minus padding and border, exposed as CSS variables. Nested frames continue the curve, FrameInner takes it, and useFrame returns the numbers.

items.name: concentric-frame-demo
items.title: Concentric Frame demo
items.description: Demo for Concentric Frame.

items.name: accordion-demo
items.title: Accordion demo
items.description: A billing FAQ with answers of different lengths.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Animated accordion for React and shadcn: panels open to their real height, one or several at a time, built on Base UI.
items.docs: Import Accordion and AccordionItem from components/eased/accordion/accordion. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: Disclosures whose height springs open with no overshoot, content fading in as the height lands and the chevron turning on the same spring. Built on Base UI Accordion.

items.name: avatar-demo
items.title: Avatar demo
items.description: A members card: a stacked group with a rolling +N, a list with photos, initials and a failed image, and Invite.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: Animated avatar for React and shadcn: images fade in from a soft blur, initials fill in when they fail, and avatar groups spread apart on hover.
items.docs: Import Avatar and AvatarGroup from components/eased/avatar/avatar. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: Avatar and AvatarGroup on Base UI Avatar: images fade in from a 4px blur once loaded, so a quick image never flashes the initials. Overlapping stacks with a cut-out ring spread apart on hover, and the overflow count rolls.

items.name: badge-demo
items.title: Badge demo

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Animated badge for React and shadcn for statuses and counts: counts roll their digits, and a count-only badge leaves at zero.
items.docs: Import Badge from components/eased/badge/badge. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: A status or count chip in six tones: counts roll their digits, and a count-only badge pops in above zero and leaves when cleared. A live dot breathes slowly and stops under reduced motion.

items.name: button-demo
items.title: Button demo
items.description: An invoice with Send (loading, then “Sent”), Download and a two-step Void.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Animated button for React and shadcn: labels swap while the width springs, and the loading spinner keeps its width.
items.docs: Import Button from components/eased/button/button. Variants: primary, secondary, ghost, danger, danger-solid. Sizes: sm, md, lg, icon-sm, icon, icon-lg. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.

meta.details: A Base UI button whose press scale depends on its width, whose label swaps with y + blur while the width springs, and whose loading spinner overlays the label so the width never changes. Popover triggers never scale.

items.name: eased-auto-height
items.title: Auto Height
items.description: The height:auto spring primitive: a wrapper whose height springs to its content, opens and closes with the content fading in after the height lands, and rests at height:auto with no clipping.

items.name: eased-field
items.title: Field shell primitive
items.description: Label, description ⇄ error message slot and the bordered input group, on Base UI Field. Focus is the border alone; turning invalid shakes the group once, 6px, and the message swaps with y + blur while its height springs.

items.name: eased-floating-demo
items.title: Floating layer demo
items.description: One popover per side; each enters toward its trigger and flips on collision.

items.name: eased-floating
items.title: Floating layer
items.description: The motion and material every Eased popup shares: grows from the trigger's transform-origin, enters a few pixels toward the trigger, closes at half the distance and faster, and reverses mid-flight because open and close are transitions. FloatingLayer renders any Base UI popup family (Tooltip, Popover, PreviewCard, Menu) with it.

items.name: eased-gesture-demo
items.title: Gesture kit demo
items.description: A three-detent sheet over a map: flicks project onto detents, pulls past the top rubber-band, and the list hands its scroll over to the sheet.

items.name: eased-gesture
items.title: Gesture kit
items.description: useDrag: one-axis drag with Apple's rubber-band past the ends, velocity projection onto snap points, scroll handoff from an inner scroller, interruptible release springs that carry the finger's velocity, and keyboard snapping. Plus the pure maths (rubberband, project, pickSnap, velocity tracker).

items.name: eased-indicator
items.title: Indicator
items.description: The shared-layout highlight primitive: render <Indicator> inside whichever item is active and it glides there on the snappy spring, with corners kept round while it stretches. Used by Segmented, Tabs, Toggle Group and Radio Cards.

items.name: eased-number-roll
items.title: Number Roll primitive
items.description: The rolling-digits engine every Eased number uses: Intl-formatted parts, each digit a ten-face cylinder on a spring that rolls in the direction of change, with locale-aware separators and numerals.

items.name: eased-scroll-fade
items.title: Scroll fades and blur ramp
items.description: Edge feathers that appear only where there is more to scroll (scrollFadeMask, useScrollEdges) and the stacked masked backdrop layers behind Progressive Blur (blurRamp, BlurStack).

items.name: eased-text-swap
items.title: Text Swap primitive
items.description: The text-change engine: outgoing text lifts 3px and blurs out, incoming rises 4px and sharpens, and the box springs to the new width. Shared by Button, Field messages and toasts.

items.name: field-demo
items.title: Field demo
items.description: A sign-up form on Base UI Form: submit focuses the first invalid field and a server error routes to its field.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: Form field for React and shadcn: a label, a control and one message line where help text and errors swap in place.
items.docs: Import Field from components/eased/field/field and put an Input, Textarea or Search Field inside. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.

meta.details: A label, a control and one message line on Base UI Field, where the description and the error swap in place with y + blur. Inside Base UI's Form, submitting focuses the first invalid field.

items.name: input-demo
items.title: Input demo
items.description: Workspace settings with a URL prefix, live validation and a disabled field.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input for React and shadcn on Base UI, with leading and trailing addons and an error state that shakes once.
items.docs: Import Input from components/eased/input/input; wrap it in Field for a label and messages. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.

meta.details: A Base UI text input whose focus firms the border and grows a soft glow. An error shakes it once, 6px, then the field's message opens with a height spring. Leading and trailing addons.

items.name: kbd-demo
items.title: Kbd demo

items.name: kbd

items.docs: Import Kbd and useKeysHeld from components/eased/kbd/kbd. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: A keycap that presses down when the real key does: the face drops 1px onto its base and springs back on release. Glyphs are announced by name; useKeysHeld lights up whatever a chord belongs to.

items.name: number-roll-demo
items.title: Number Roll demo

items.name: number-roll
items.title: Number Roll
items.description: Animated number counter for React and shadcn: each digit rolls to its new value, formatted for the user's locale.
items.docs: Import NumberRoll from components/eased/number-roll/number-roll. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: Tabular digits that roll in the direction of change, formatted with Intl.NumberFormat for any locale. A 9 → 0 carry rolls forward, a value that changes mid-roll redirects, and new places fade in while the rest slide over.

items.name: popover-demo

meta.details: A panel that opens from its trigger's transform-origin with a 5px directional offset, closes at half the distance in 150ms, and reverses mid-flight. Its trigger presses by colour, never by scale.

items.name: progress-demo

items.name: progress

items.docs: Import Progress from components/eased/progress/progress. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: A progress bar on Base UI Progress: the bar rides a spring that never overshoots, and its value rolls. An unknown length sweeps on an accelerate–decelerate curve and hands over to the bar the moment a value arrives.

items.name: progressive-blur-demo

meta.details: A blur that ramps from 0 to 20px over 80px toward an edge, from stacked masked backdrop layers, for headers, bottom bars and composers. Optionally scroll-linked so it appears only once content is underneath.

items.name: radio-group-demo

items.docs: Import RadioGroup, Radio, RadioCards and RadioCard from components/eased/radio-group/radio-group. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

items.docs: Import Segmented from components/eased/segmented/segmented. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: A single-choice segmented control whose thumb glides to the selection on a spring. Base UI RadioGroup behaviour, concentric thumb, labels that never change weight.

items.name: skeleton-demo

items.docs: Import Skeleton and SkeletonText from components/eased/skeleton/skeleton. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: Loading placeholders with one page-wide shimmer: every skeleton shares a highlight and a phase, so a single band sweeps across them all. Wrap the real content and it hands off in place, fading in from a soft blur.

items.name: spinner-demo

items.name: spinner

items.docs: Import Spinner from components/eased/spinner/spinner. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: A loading spinner that turns on the compositor, so it keeps spinning while the main thread is busy, and announces itself unless visible text already does. A quarter arc on a faint ring, the eased.dev status-badge mark; it pauses off-screen and freezes under reduced motion.

items.name: tabs-demo

items.docs: Import Tabs, TabsList, Tab, TabsPanels and TabsPanel from components/eased/tabs/tabs. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: Tabs with a gliding indicator (underline or pill) and panels that cross-fade 6px in the direction of travel while their container's height springs. Base UI Tabs behaviour.

items.name: text-swap-demo
items.title: Text Swap demo

items.name: text-swap
items.title: Text Swap
items.description: Animated text change for React and shadcn: a label or value swaps with a lift and blur while the width springs to fit.
items.docs: Import TextSwap from components/eased/text-swap/text-swap. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: Change a label, status or short value with y + blur, and spring the width to fit, so neighbours glide instead of jumping. Direction-aware for counts and steps.

items.name: textarea-demo

items.name: textarea

items.docs: Import Textarea from components/eased/textarea/textarea; wrap it in Field for a label and messages. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.

meta.details: A textarea that grows with its text on a smooth height spring instead of jumping a line at a time. The character counter rolls its digits and turns warning-coloured at 90%.

items.name: toggle-group-demo

items.name: toggle-group

items.docs: Import ToggleGroup and ToggleGroupItem from components/eased/toggle-group/toggle-group. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: Toggle buttons sharing one highlight: it travels between items in single mode, and pressed neighbours fuse into one shape in multiple mode. Base UI ToggleGroup behaviour.

items.name: tooltip-demo
items.title: Tooltip demo

meta.details: A short label that waits 400ms for the first trigger, then follows the pointer instantly across its neighbours. Enters 3px toward its trigger, shows an optional shortcut, never appears on touch.

items.name: cells-demo
items.title: Cells kit demo
items.description: An accounts table: advance a month and MRR rolls, deltas recolour, onboarding meters glide, and active accounts breathe.

items.name: cells
items.title: Cells kit

items.docs: Import PersonCell, StatusCell, DeltaCell, ProgressCell, RelativeTimeCell and IdCell from components/eased/cells/cells. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: Table cells that make rows look finished: avatar with name, status badge, number with a rolling value and coloured delta, a progress meter that fills on view, a self-updating relative time, and a mono ID with a copy button.

items.name: eased-table-core
items.title: Table core primitive
items.description: The layer under every Eased table: a TanStack Table v9 feature set with typed column meta, hairline rules, dense and comfortable densities, a hover-revealed sort button, a semantic table renderer, and two motion hooks: useRowFlip (rows glide to a new order) and useSelectionStagger (a range selection lights up row by row).

items.name: table-demo
items.title: Table demo
items.description: An invoices table with mono IDs you can copy, avatars, status badges, amounts and relative dates, with a density toggle.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Data table for React and shadcn on TanStack Table, with half-pixel row rules, a sticky header and 36px or 48px rows.
items.docs: Import Table and easedColumns from components/eased/table/table. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: A hairline table on TanStack Table: half-pixel row rules, a quiet sentence-case header, numbers right-aligned on one edge, one emphasised cell per row, a sticky header, and dense or comfortable rows.

items.name: attachment-demo
items.title: Attachment Chip demo
items.description: A message draft with an upload in flight, a finished deck and a failed CSV with Retry.

items.name: attachment
items.title: Attachment Chip
items.description: File attachment chip for React and shadcn: image thumbnails sharpen as they load, a ring tracks the upload, and failures offer Retry.
items.docs: Import AttachmentChip and AttachmentList from components/eased/attachment/attachment-chip. Pair with useAttachments from components/eased/_primitives/chat-core/chat-core.

meta.details: A chat attachment: images as a thumbnail that sharpens from a blur once decoded, files as a typed chip. Upload progress is a ring that springs between reports; a failure shakes once and offers Retry; removing one lets its neighbours slide into the gap.

items.name: composer-demo
items.title: Composer demo
items.description: A working mini chat: send, attach, stop mid-reply, scroll up while it streams.

items.name: composer
items.title: Composer
items.description: AI chat input for React and shadcn: the box grows as you type, files drop or paste in, and Send morphs into Stop while a reply streams.
items.docs: Import Composer from components/eased/composer/composer. With AI SDK: const { composer } = fromUseChat(useChat()); <Composer {...composer} />.

meta.details: A chat composer that grows on a spring, opens an attachments row with Auto Height, and morphs its Send arrow into a Stop square while a reply streams. Enter sends, Shift+Enter breaks the line, Escape stops; files can be picked, dropped or pasted. Wires straight into AI SDK useChat.

items.name: eased-chat-core
items.title: Chat core primitive
items.description: The chat model and hooks behind Eased's chat components: AI SDK UIMessage-compatible types, useStickToBottom, message grouping, the attachment model with useAttachments, composer key handling with slash/mention triggers, and a useChat adapter.

items.name: message-demo
items.title: Message demo
items.description: Follow-ups that merge into one run of bubbles, corners tightening as each lands.

items.name: message
items.title: Message
items.description: Chat message bubble for React and shadcn that renders AI SDK messages, tightening the corners where consecutive bubbles meet.
items.docs: Import Message, MessageAction and CopyAction from components/eased/message/message. Group with groupMessages from chat-core.

meta.details: A chat message: the user's in a sunken bubble on the right, the assistant's flush on the left. Consecutive bubbles from one author merge, their touching corners tightening as the next one lands. Renders AI SDK UIMessage text and file parts.

items.name: eased-thinking-core

items.name: shimmer-text-demo

meta.details: Shimmer text for React: a soft band of light sweeps across a label while something is working. Every shimmer on the page shares one phase, status changes swap in without restarting the band, and turning it off fades the band out in place.

items.name: thinking-bar-demo

items.name: agent-orb-demo

items.name: eased-chart-core

items.name: eased-layout

items.name: eased-code-core
items.title: Code core primitive
items.description: The engine behind Eased code components: a lazily loaded Shiki singleton (shiki/core + the JavaScript regex engine, grammars for tsx, ts, js, jsx, json, css, bash, html, md, python and diff loaded on demand), the eased-stone (dark) and eased-cream (light) themes, light/dark token lines rendered with CSS light-dark(), the line decoration model (highlight, focus, added, removed, plus the DiffHunk contract), the copy → check morph, collapse-after under a progressive blur, and a page-wide synced choice store.

items.name: snippet-demo
items.title: Snippet demo
items.description: An install card: a package-manager switch drives two commands, plus a long git clone that scrolls under edge fades.

items.name: snippet
items.title: Snippet
items.description: Copyable command snippet for React and shadcn: one shell line with a $ prompt that is never copied, and a copy button that turns into a check.
items.docs: Import Snippet from components/eased/snippet/snippet. Pair it with useChoice("package-manager") from code-core and packageCommand from code-tabs to follow the reader's package manager.

meta.details: A copyable command snippet: one line with a $ prompt and a copy button that morphs into a check. When the command changes (pnpm ↔ npm) the text swaps and the width springs, so the copy button glides instead of jumping.

items.name: eased-skill
items.title: Eased design skill
items.description: The design skill Eased is built with, as an agent skill: alignment, the 1:2 spacing ratio, concentric radii, springs per role, enter and exit, focus rings, reduced motion, and how to install and compose Eased components.
items.docs: Installed to .claude/skills/eased/SKILL.md, where Claude Code loads it on demand. For Cursor, copy it to .cursor/rules/eased.mdc; for Codex and other agents, reference it from AGENTS.md.

items.name: eased-mac
items.title: Eased Mac
items.description: The macOS look the Mac pack shares: the San Francisco font stack, frosted popover and HUD materials in light and dark, hairlines and macOS corner radii, with a native mode that leaves vibrancy to a Tauri or Electron window and a hook that follows the system appearance there.

items.name: mac-hud-demo
items.title: Mac HUD demo
items.description: A small macOS desktop with media keys: nudge volume, brightness and keyboard backlight (hold to repeat, or use the arrow keys) and switch between the classic and pill HUD.

items.name: mac-hud
items.title: Mac HUD
items.description: macOS volume and brightness HUD for React and shadcn, square or macOS 26 pill, updating in place and holding 1.1s after each change.
items.docs: Import MacHud and useMacHud from components/eased/mac-hud/mac-hud. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Call show(kind, value) from useMacHud() and spread hud onto <MacHud>. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark". In a Tauri or Electron HUD window with native vibrancy, pass material="native" and position="none", hide the window in onExitComplete, keep html and body transparent, and call useSystemAppearance() from components/eased/lib/mac so dark follows the system.

meta.details: The macOS volume and brightness overlay: a frosted, click-through HUD in the classic 200×200 square or the macOS 26 pill. Repeat changes update it in place and restart its 1.1s hold; it never replays its entrance.

items.name: mac-menu-popover-demo

items.name: mac-menu-popover
items.title: Mac menu popover
items.description: macOS menu bar popover for React and shadcn, for Tauri and Electron apps: the panel grows from its arrow tip and reverses mid-flight.
items.docs: Import MacMenuPopover, MacStatusItem, MacMenuPopoverContent, MacMenuItem and MacMenuSeparator from components/eased/mac-menu-popover/mac-menu-popover. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Put MacStatusItem (with a label) and MacMenuPopoverContent inside MacMenuPopover, and wrap rows that should close the panel in MacMenuPopoverClose. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark". In a Tauri or Electron tray window, render MacMenuPanel instead; it defaults to material="native" (a CSS blur cannot see the desktop there). Keep html and body transparent and call useSystemAppearance() from components/eased/lib/mac so dark follows the system.

meta.details: A macOS menu bar popover: a status item and a frosted panel whose arrow and panel are one shape, so one blur and one hairline follow the arrow. It grows from the arrow tip, reverses mid-flight, and drops its CSS blur for native Tauri or Electron vibrancy.

Props: data, xKey, series ({ key, label }), compare, label, color, curve, height, format, formatTick, formatX, formatXDetail, onActiveChange. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import. Dark mode follows .dark or data-theme="dark".

meta.details: An area chart that draws in once and morphs to new data from the shape on screen while its scale springs. A crosshair glides between points, a tooltip trails it, and an optional dashed line compares a previous period.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card component for React and shadcn with shadcn's parts and slots, plus a CardLink that makes the whole card one clickable link.
items.docs: Import Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardAction, CardContent, CardFooter and CardLink from components/eased/card/card. Card props: size (default, sm), autoHeight. CardTitle and CardLink take render. The Eased tokens were merged into your global CSS; nothing to import.

meta.details: A card with shadcn's parts and slots, so it swaps straight in. A static card holds still; with a CardLink the whole card lifts, presses and rings as one link, and autoHeight springs its height as content changes.

meta.details: Book a visit in three choices: provider and day highlights glide, the day's slots re-tint in a ripple, and the picked time lifts out of the grid into the confirmation card before Book morphs to Booked.

items.name: caption-ticker
items.title: Caption Ticker
items.description: An animated caption ticker for React and shadcn, stepping short captions in under a scene one line at a time.
items.docs: Import CaptionTicker from components/eased/caption-ticker/caption-ticker. Give each caption a duration to run it on its own clock, or pass index from a useDemoTimeline step.

meta.details: Short captions that step in under a scene with Text Swap's motion: the old line lifts and blurs out, the new one rises in, and the width springs to fit. Each line has its own timing, or a scene's timeline drives it; screen readers get every line at once.

items.name: click-ripple
items.title: Click Ripple
items.description: An animated click ripple for React and shadcn, a ring that spreads from the exact press point.
items.docs: Import ClickRipple from components/eased/click-ripple/click-ripple and mount it inside any positioned element. It rings at real pointer presses and at Demo Cursor presses inside that element.

meta.details: A press ring for clicks you want seen in demos, recordings and tutorials. A soft disc marks the press, then a 1.5px ring grows from that exact point on the smooth spring and fades. It rings at real presses on its parent and at a Demo Cursor's presses, so a scripted click and a real one look the same.

items.name: demo-cursor
items.title: Demo Cursor
items.description: An animated demo cursor for React and shadcn, a scripted pointer that glides to real elements and presses them.
items.docs: Import DemoCursor from components/eased/demo-cursor/demo-cursor and useDemoTimeline from components/eased/_primitives/demo-core/demo-core. Put the cursor inside the positioned element that holds the UI; targets are refs or data-demo names inside it.

meta.details: A pointer for product demos over live UI, not a video. It glides on a spring along a shallow arc to an element by ref or data-demo name, stays on it through resizes, presses it so the element depresses, drags in a straight line, and wears an optional name pill. Under reduced motion it jumps to each target.

items.name: demo-scene
items.title: Product demo scene
items.description: The Product demo set on one timeline: a cursor presses Deploy, a ripple rings, the label swaps, the build count rolls, a caption steps on and the view pushes in on the live deploy, then it loops.

items.name: eased-demo-core
items.title: Demo core primitive
items.description: What the Product demo set shares: useDemoTimeline, one drift-free clock of named steps that plays, loops, seeks, pauses off-screen and in hidden tabs, and rests on its result under reduced motion; DemoTarget, an element by ref, a data-demo name or a point; and the press event a Click Ripple rings at.

items.name: zoom-spotlight
items.title: Zoom Spotlight
items.description: An animated zoom spotlight for React and shadcn, pushing in on one region of live UI and dimming the rest.
items.docs: Import ZoomSpotlight from components/eased/zoom-spotlight/zoom-spotlight. Wrap the UI in it, give it a size, and name the region with a ref or a data-demo attribute.

meta.details: Pushes in on a region of live UI the way a screen recording does: the view scales and pans on the smooth spring until the target sits centred, the rest dims behind a cutout that follows its corners, and it springs back when you let go. It never zooms past the edges and follows the target through resizes.
